summary: 88th issue of One Page Love's Love Letter, with fresh one-pager picks, Framer templates and online finds.
description: The 88th Love Letter from One Page Love: a newsletter issue that spotlights recently featured one-page websites (Cursor Compile, Landmark, Patina, Wickside, Aaavatar, Weppy, Sarah & Matt Wedding, Fourmula), free and paid Framer landing page templates, and a Digital Snacks list of resources, including the new 1,512+ Open Graph image archive and theSVG's 6,100+ icons. It also announces 110 newly curated page sections.
